description: This file defines an interface class IEventHandler with virtual methods for handling OCI container events such as start, stop, failure, and state change, within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: An interface class for handling OCI container events, with pure virtual methods that must be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStartedEvent
methods.description: Handles the event when an OCI container starts, taking the container name and data as parameters.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStoppedEvent
methods.description: Handles the event when an OCI container stops, taking the container name and data as parameters.

methods.name: onOCIContainerFailureEvent
methods.description: Handles the event when an OCI container fails, taking the container name and data as parameters.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Handles the event when an OCI container's state changes, taking the container name and data as parameters.
